findings.fix: Remove the @media rule that hides #main-content in portrait orientation, or restructure the layout to remain accessible in all orientations.
findings.violation: The @media (orientation: portrait) rule hides the main content (#main-content) entirely in portrait orientation, restricting the page to landscape viewing only.

findings.fix: Set the field's autocomplete attribute to email, or the matching standard token for this input purpose.
findings.violation: This field's type, name, or id identifies the email input purpose, but it carries no autocomplete token, so the purpose is not programmatically determinable.

findings.fix: Remove the style="outline:none" attribute or provide an alternative visible focus indicator (e.g., a visible border or background color change).
findings.violation: The navigation link has an inline outline:none style that removes the focus indicator, making it invisible to keyboard users.

findings.evidence: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol" style="width:16px;height:16px">
findings.fix: Increase the target size to at least 24x24 CSS pixels, either by adjusting the element's width and height or by adding padding.
findings.location: #s3-customcontrol, <div> custom button control, role="button" tabindex="0", line 45
findings.violation: The custom button control has inline styles setting width and height to 16px, which is below the 24x24 CSS pixel minimum target size for touchable controls.

findings.fix: Add aria-live="polite" (or aria-live="assertive" if urgent) to the status message container.
findings.violation: The status message 'Your changes are saved.' lacks an aria-live region attribute to announce dynamic status updates to screen reader users.
